body: Founder, real-time: 'write a blog post memorial cerimony for the incident titel of your choice.' Chose the S24-06/S24-07 prwatch-body crawler deadlock as the incident -- a single unbounded HTTP fetch held all 4 crawler workers hostage for 4.5 hours with zero symptoms visible from outside the process. Published via IDUNA blog.write API, live at https://okemily.com/blog/uptime-is-not-aliveness/. Footer synced, deployed, verified live. OKEMILY 9244e32.
title: Blog: 'Uptime Is Not Aliveness' — memorial post for the prwatch-body deadlock incident
